system.flavor:
Let a liar overplay his hand, lead a boaster into claiming more than he can back up, or give a cheat the opening that makes him clumsy. One person, one try, and he is worse at it than he should be.

Not enough to make anyone stop trying or to fool more than one.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy declares an attack against you, before rolling. Response: On success, impose -1 on that attack's Success Die; you take -1 Fortitude against it if your Reaction misses.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit away.
On a hit, suppress its ordinary accuracy bonuses for that attack, to a maximum reduction of 1.
